Mobile / Communication

LaserDeck PTT

Bluetooth communication between Android devices.

Bluetooth push-to-talk, calls, messages and photo transfer between two Android phones.

Test build

The need

Direct nearby communication without an account or internet connection.

Approach

An Android app built on Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM, with PTT and supporting distance tools.

Current scope and limits

The v2.1.0 installation page is accessible and describes closed testing. This is not optical laser hardware; no new two-device test was performed.

Published information checked on 5 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
